items.q: Tell me about yourself.
items.q_zh: 請自我介紹。
items.intent_zh: 面試官要的是 60 秒版本的「我是誰＋做過什麼＋為什麼坐在這裡」，不是履歷復誦。
outline_zh: 一句話定位：職稱＋年資＋領域
一個可量化的代表作
為什麼想要這個職位（接到下一題）
items.answer: I'm a device engineer with six years in NAND flash yield analysis. My main job is to find why wafers fail at sort and to close the issue with the fab. Last year I led the root cause analysis for a program disturb excursion that cost us three points of yield. I'm now looking for a role where I can work more directly with overseas customers.
items.answer_zh: 我是元件工程師，在 NAND flash 良率分析領域六年。我主要負責找出晶圓在 sort 失效的原因，並和廠端一起把問題收掉。去年我主導了一次 program disturb 異常的根因分析，那次事件讓我們掉了三個百分點的良率。我現在想找一個能更直接面對海外客戶的職位。
items.core: I'm a device engineer with six years in NAND flash yield analysis.

key_phrases.en: My main job is to ...
key_phrases.zh: 我主要負責⋯

key_phrases.en: Last year I led the root cause analysis for ...
key_phrases.zh: 去年我主導了⋯的根因分析

key_phrases.en: I'm now looking for a role where I can ...
key_phrases.zh: 我現在想找一個能⋯的職位

follow_ups.en: What made you choose yield analysis?
follow_ups.zh: 你為什麼選良率分析這條路？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一個具體的轉折點，不要講「因為我對半導體有興趣」。

follow_ups.en: Which part of that work do you actually enjoy?
follow_ups.zh: 這份工作你真正享受的是哪一部分？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 挑一件小而具體的事（例如看 bitmap 找 pattern），比「我喜歡解決問題」可信。

follow_ups.en: So why leave a job you enjoy?
follow_ups.zh: 那你為什麼要離開一份你享受的工作？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 把理由接回剛才講的興趣——想做更貼近客戶的那一段，不要批評現在的公司。

dont.en: I was born in Taichung and I graduated from a national university in 2015...
dont.why_zh: 從出生講起會用掉全部時間；面試的自我介紹只講與這份工作有關的事。

items.q: Walk me through your resume.
items.q_zh: 請帶我看一遍你的履歷。
items.intent_zh: 面試官要的是「每一次轉換的邏輯」，不是時間軸復述。
outline_zh: 最早的職位一句話帶過
每次轉換都給一個理由
停在現在，接到為什麼想來
items.answer: I started as a process engineer in the etch module in 2019. After two years I moved to yield analysis because I wanted to see the whole line, not one step. Since 2022 I have owned sort yield for two NAND products. In the last two years I also handled customer 8D reports, which is why this role interests me.
items.answer_zh: 我 2019 年從蝕刻模組的製程工程師開始。兩年後轉到良率分析，因為我想看整條線，而不是單一站別。2022 年起我負責兩個 NAND 產品的 sort yield。最近兩年我也處理客戶的 8D 報告，這也是我對這個職位有興趣的原因。
items.core: After two years I moved to yield analysis because I wanted to see the whole line, not one step.

key_phrases.en: I started as ... in ...
key_phrases.zh: 我最早是在⋯做⋯

key_phrases.en: Since 2022 I have owned ...
key_phrases.zh: 2022 年起我負責⋯

key_phrases.en: which is why this role interests me
key_phrases.zh: 這也是我對這個職位有興趣的原因

follow_ups.en: Why did you leave the process side?
follow_ups.zh: 你為什麼離開製程那邊？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講「往哪裡去」，不要講「從哪裡逃」。

follow_ups.en: Is there a gap between those two roles?
follow_ups.zh: 這兩份工作之間有空窗嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 有就直說那段時間做了什麼；沒有就講兩份工作怎麼銜接。

follow_ups.en: Which of these roles taught you the most?
follow_ups.zh: 哪一份工作讓你學到最多？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 挑一個，並說出「學到什麼、現在還在用」。

dont.en: Then I changed to another department, and then I changed again.
dont.why_zh: 只講換過什麼、不講為什麼換，會被讀成待不住。

items.q: Can you describe your current team and your role in it?
items.q_zh: 可以描述一下你現在的團隊，以及你在裡面的角色嗎？
items.intent_zh: 確認你的實際位置：負責多大範圍、對誰負責、是不是關鍵人。
outline_zh: 團隊規模與守備範圍
你個人 own 的部分
出事時你扮演什麼角色
items.answer: My team has eight engineers and we cover sort yield for all NAND products in the fab. I own two product families and I'm the contact window for customer quality issues. When there is an excursion, I lead the analysis and I report the status every day to the program manager.
items.answer_zh: 我的團隊有八個工程師，負責廠內所有 NAND 產品的 sort yield。我負責兩個產品家族，也是客戶品質問題的對外窗口。發生異常時，由我主導分析，並每天向 program manager 回報進度。
items.core: When there is an excursion, I lead the analysis and I report the status every day to the program manager.

key_phrases.en: My team has eight engineers and we cover ...
key_phrases.zh: 我的團隊有八個工程師，負責⋯

key_phrases.en: I'm the contact window for ...
key_phrases.zh: 我是⋯的對外窗口

follow_ups.en: How much of that is your own decision?
follow_ups.zh: 其中有多少是你自己決定的？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給一個你自己拍板的例子，含你當時承擔的風險。

follow_ups.en: Who do you go to when you are stuck?
follow_ups.zh: 你卡住的時候會找誰？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 展示你知道怎麼借力，不是硬撐。

follow_ups.en: What would break if you left tomorrow?
follow_ups.zh: 如果你明天離職，什麼會出問題？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 誠實講一兩件，順便帶出你有在留文件與交接。

dont.en: I just do what my manager assigns to me.
dont.why_zh: 把自己講成純執行者，面試官會認為你沒有 ownership。

items.q: How would your colleagues describe you?
items.q_zh: 你的同事會怎麼形容你？
items.intent_zh: 用第三人稱說優點比自誇可信；同時在測你有沒有自我認知。
outline_zh: 一個具體的形容（別用 hard-working）
用一個行為證明它
加一句合作面的評價
items.answer: They would say I'm the person who asks for the raw data. I don't accept a conclusion until I see the wafer map myself. My module colleagues also say I'm easy to work with, because I bring evidence first and I don't blame their process before I check my own analysis.
items.answer_zh: 他們大概會說我是那種一定會要原始資料的人。在我自己看過晶圓圖之前，我不會接受任何結論。模組端的同事也說我很好合作，因為我先拿證據出來，而且在檢查完自己的分析之前不會先怪他們的製程。
items.core: I don't accept a conclusion until I see the wafer map myself.

key_phrases.en: They would say I'm the person who ...
key_phrases.zh: 他們大概會說我是那種會⋯的人

key_phrases.en: My colleagues say I'm easy to work with, because ...
key_phrases.zh: 同事說我很好合作，因為⋯

follow_ups.en: And what would they say you need to improve?
follow_ups.zh: 那他們會說你哪裡需要改進？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講真的缺點＋你正在做的補救，不要講「我太追求完美」。

follow_ups.en: Can you give me an example of that?
follow_ups.zh: 可以舉個例子嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 一個具體場景，不要用抽象形容詞帶過。

follow_ups.en: Has anyone ever found you difficult to work with?
follow_ups.zh: 有人覺得跟你合作很難嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 承認一次摩擦並說你怎麼調整，比否認可信得多。

dont.en: They say I am hard-working and responsible.
dont.why_zh: 每個人都這樣講等於沒講；要給行為證據。

items.q: Tell me about the project you are most proud of.
items.q_zh: 講一個你最引以為傲的專案。
items.intent_zh: 看你能不能把專案講成「問題 → 行動 → 可量化結果」，而不是流水帳。
outline_zh: 一句話講問題與衝擊（帶數字）
你做的關鍵動作
結果與後續影響（制度化／省了多少）
items.answer: Last year we lost three points of sort yield on our main product. I found the failures came from one furnace tube by overlaying lot history on the wafer maps. We changed the tube recipe and recovered the yield in three weeks. The fix is now part of the standard control plan.
items.answer_zh: 去年我們主力產品掉了三個百分點的 sort yield。我把批次履歷疊到晶圓圖上，找出失效來自其中一支爐管。我們改了該爐管的配方，三週內把良率救回來。這個對策現在已經納入標準管制計畫。
items.core: We changed the tube recipe and recovered the yield in three weeks.

key_phrases.en: We lost three points of sort yield on ...
key_phrases.zh: 我們在⋯掉了三個百分點的 sort yield

key_phrases.en: I found the failures came from ... by ...
key_phrases.zh: 我用⋯找出失效來自⋯

key_phrases.en: The fix is now part of the standard control plan.
key_phrases.zh: 這個對策已經納入標準管制計畫。

follow_ups.en: What would you do differently if it happened again?
follow_ups.zh: 如果再來一次你會做什麼不一樣的？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一個你真的改掉的做法，不是「我會更小心」。

follow_ups.en: What was the hardest decision you had to make in it?
follow_ups.zh: 那件事裡你做過最難的決定是什麼？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講取捨（時間 vs 樣本數、放行 vs 擋貨），不要講技術細節。

follow_ups.en: How do you know the result was because of you?
follow_ups.zh: 你怎麼知道那個成果是因為你？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給可歸因的證據：你做了什麼動作、之後數字怎麼變。

dont.en: I did many projects, all of them are important.
dont.why_zh: 不挑一個講細節，面試官無法判斷你的深度。

items.q: Describe the most difficult yield issue you have solved.
items.q_zh: 描述一個你解過最難的良率問題。
items.intent_zh: 難在哪、你怎麼在資訊不足時逼近答案。
outline_zh: 為什麼難（訊號弱／不可重現／跨部門）
你用什麼方法縮小範圍
花多久、根因是什麼
items.answer: The hardest one was an intermittent bit failure that only appeared after high temperature stress. The failure rate was too low for normal SPC to catch. I built a query to pull two years of test logs and found the failures clustered on wafers from one implanter. The root cause was a slow drift in the tilt angle.
items.answer_zh: 最難的一次是間歇性的 bit 失效，只有在高溫應力之後才出現。失效率太低，一般的 SPC 抓不到。我寫了一個查詢把兩年的測試 log 拉出來，發現失效集中在同一台離子佈植機的晶圓上。根因是傾角的緩慢飄移。
items.core: The failure rate was too low for normal SPC to catch.

key_phrases.en: It only appeared after high temperature stress.
key_phrases.zh: 它只在高溫應力後才出現。

key_phrases.en: I built a query to pull two years of test logs.
key_phrases.zh: 我寫了一個查詢把兩年的測試 log 拉出來。

key_phrases.en: The root cause was a slow drift in ...
key_phrases.zh: 根因是⋯的緩慢飄移。

follow_ups.en: How did you keep the team patient for four months?
follow_ups.zh: 四個月你怎麼讓團隊保持耐心？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你怎麼讓進度可見（每週一個小結論），不是「大家都很配合」。

follow_ups.en: At what point did you think you might not solve it?
follow_ups.zh: 你哪個時間點覺得可能解不掉？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 誠實講最低點，再講你當時改了什麼做法。

follow_ups.en: What would you have done if you never found the root cause?
follow_ups.zh: 如果最後找不到根因，你會怎麼辦？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講 containment，以及怎麼和客戶溝通「查不到但控制得住」。

dont.en: It was difficult because many people were involved.
dont.why_zh: 人多不是技術難度；面試官要聽的是資料與推理上的困難。

items.q: What exactly was your contribution to that project?
items.q_zh: 那個專案裡，具體哪些是你做的？
items.intent_zh: 追問你在團隊功勞裡的實際份額；模糊回答＝扣分。
outline_zh: 直接說哪幾件事是你做的
誠實說別人做了什麼
收在你對外負責的部分
items.answer: The data pipeline and the root cause hypothesis were mine. I wrote the script that joined test data with equipment history, and I proposed the implanter as the suspect. The module engineer ran the confirmation experiment. I owned the 8D report and presented it to the customer.
items.answer_zh: 資料管線與根因假設是我做的。我寫了把測試資料與機台履歷併起來的腳本，也是我提出離子佈植機是嫌疑者。確認實驗是模組工程師跑的。8D 報告由我負責，也是我對客戶簡報。
items.core: I wrote the script that joined test data with equipment history.

key_phrases.en: The data pipeline and the hypothesis were mine.
key_phrases.zh: 資料管線與假設是我做的。

key_phrases.en: I owned the 8D report and presented it to the customer.
key_phrases.zh: 8D 報告由我負責，也是我對客戶簡報。

follow_ups.en: What part could you not have done alone?
follow_ups.zh: 哪一部分你自己一個人做不到？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 承認需要別人，反而顯得你清楚邊界。

follow_ups.en: What would have happened without you?
follow_ups.zh: 如果沒有你，結果會怎樣？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 用「本來會怎樣」對比，比自誇有效。

follow_ups.en: Who else deserves credit, and for what?
follow_ups.zh: 還有誰該被記上一功？為什麼？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 具名給功勞會讓你的貢獻更可信，不是更少。

dont.en: We did everything together as a team.
dont.why_zh: 全部推給團隊，面試官會認為你沒有可驗證的個人能力。

items.q: How do you handle a customer complaint about quality?
items.q_zh: 客戶客訴品質問題時，你怎麼處理？
items.intent_zh: 看你懂不懂「先止血再破案」，以及對客戶溝通的節奏感。
outline_zh: 先圍堵：確認範圍、hold 住同批
24 小時內先給暫時回覆
再走 8D 與定期更新
items.answer: First I confirm the scope and put the sister lots on hold, so the problem does not get bigger. Then I give the customer a containment answer within twenty four hours, even if I don't have the root cause yet. After that I follow the 8D flow and send a status update every week.
items.answer_zh: 我會先確認範圍並把同批貨 hold 住，避免問題擴大。接著在 24 小時內先給客戶圍堵對策的回覆，即使根因還沒找到。之後照 8D 流程走，並每週發出進度更新。
items.core: I give the customer a containment answer within twenty four hours.

key_phrases.en: First I confirm the scope and put the sister lots on hold.
key_phrases.zh: 我先確認範圍並把同批貨 hold 住。

key_phrases.en: I send a status update every week until the report is closed.
key_phrases.zh: 我每週發進度更新直到報告結案。

follow_ups.en: What if you still have no root cause after four weeks?
follow_ups.zh: 如果四週後還是沒有根因呢？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你怎麼分階段回覆，而不是等到有答案才開口。

follow_ups.en: How do you decide what to tell the customer and what to hold?
follow_ups.zh: 你怎麼決定哪些告訴客戶、哪些先不講？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 原則是「已知、未知、下一步」；還沒驗證的事不要承諾。

follow_ups.en: Has a customer ever escalated over your head?
follow_ups.zh: 有客戶越過你直接告狀嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 有就講你怎麼收；沒有就講你怎麼提前避免。

dont.en: I wait until I find the root cause, then I reply to the customer.
dont.why_zh: 客戶要的是先看到控制動作；等你破案，客訴早就升級了。

items.q: Tell me about a time you worked with people outside your team.
items.q_zh: 講一次你和其他部門合作的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 跨部門協作能力；重點在你建立了什麼機制，不是你多努力。
outline_zh: 情境：牽涉哪些部門、衝突在哪
你建立的機制（單一真相、短會議）
結果
items.answer: During a qualification for a new customer I had to work with process, test, and the sales team at the same time. Each side wanted a different priority. I set up one shared tracking sheet and a fifteen minute call every morning. We closed the qualification two weeks before the deadline.
items.answer_zh: 在一個新客戶的認證案裡，我必須同時和製程、測試與業務三邊合作，每一方想要的優先順序都不一樣。我建了一份共用的追蹤表，加上每天早上十五分鐘的會議。我們比期限提前兩週完成認證。
items.core: I set up one shared tracking sheet and a fifteen minute call every morning.

key_phrases.en: Each side wanted a different priority.
key_phrases.zh: 每一方想要的優先順序都不一樣。

key_phrases.en: We closed the qualification two weeks before the deadline.
key_phrases.zh: 我們提前兩週完成認證。

follow_ups.en: Who was the hardest to align, and why?
follow_ups.zh: 最難對齊的是誰？為什麼？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 對事不對人，講清楚對方的立場合理在哪。

follow_ups.en: What did you change about how you asked?
follow_ups.zh: 你改變了自己要求的方式嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 重點在你調整了什麼，不是對方多難搞。

follow_ups.en: Would that person work with you again?
follow_ups.zh: 那個人還會願意跟你合作嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 用一個後續事實佐證（例如他後來主動找你）。

dont.en: I sent many emails to push everyone.
dont.why_zh: 發信不是方法；面試官想看的是你設計了什麼流程。

items.q: Have you ever led a project without being a manager?
items.q_zh: 你有沒有在沒有職權的情況下帶過專案？
items.intent_zh: 沒有職權的領導力，是升遷與外商面試最愛問的一題。
outline_zh: 說有，給規模（幾人、跨幾個部門）
坦白沒有職權，所以你用什麼取代
結果
items.answer: Yes. I led the excursion task force last year with five people from three departments. I had no authority over them, so I ran it with clear owners and dates on every action item. I also made sure everyone saw the same daily dashboard. The team stayed together until we closed the case.
items.answer_zh: 有。去年我帶了異常處理的任務小組，五個人來自三個部門。我對他們沒有職權，所以我用「每個行動項都有負責人與日期」的方式來推。我也確保所有人看到同一份每日儀表板。整個小組一直撐到案子結掉。
items.core: I had no authority over them, so I ran it with clear owners and dates.

key_phrases.en: I led the task force with five people from three departments.
key_phrases.zh: 我帶了跨三個部門、五個人的任務小組。

key_phrases.en: clear owners and dates on every action item
key_phrases.zh: 每個行動項都有負責人與日期

follow_ups.en: What did you do when someone missed a date?
follow_ups.zh: 有人沒趕上日期時你怎麼做？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 先問卡在哪、再談新日期，不要先追責。

follow_ups.en: How did you get authority you did not have?
follow_ups.zh: 你沒有職權，怎麼推得動？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講資訊透明、把決定變成大家的、必要時請主管背書。

follow_ups.en: Would you want to be a manager?
follow_ups.zh: 你想當主管嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給明確方向，不要含糊說「都可以」。

dont.en: No, I am not a manager, so I never led anything.
dont.why_zh: 把 leadership 等同職稱，等於自己放棄這一題。

items.q: What tools do you use in your daily work?
items.q_zh: 你日常工作用哪些工具？
items.intent_zh: 確認你的工具深度，也在看你會不會誠實劃界線。
outline_zh: 統計工具與資料查詢
自動化與程式語言
誠實說到哪裡為止
items.answer: I use JMP for statistics and SQL to pull test data from the yield database. For repeated analysis I write Python scripts, mostly pandas for data cleaning. For wafer level patterns I use our in-house map viewer. I'm not a software engineer, but I automate anything I have to do more than twice.
items.answer_zh: 統計我用 JMP，資料則用 SQL 從良率資料庫拉。重複性的分析我寫 Python，主要是用 pandas 清資料。晶圓層級的圖案我用公司內部的 map viewer。我不是軟體工程師，但只要一件事要做兩次以上，我就會把它自動化。
items.core: I'm not a software engineer, but I automate anything I have to do more than twice.

key_phrases.en: I use SQL to pull test data from the yield database.
key_phrases.zh: 我用 SQL 從良率資料庫拉測試資料。

key_phrases.en: For repeated analysis I write Python scripts.
key_phrases.zh: 重複性的分析我寫 Python 腳本。

follow_ups.en: How would you find a correlation in that data?
follow_ups.zh: 你會怎麼在那些資料裡找相關性？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講步驟，順便說你怎麼避免看到假訊號。

follow_ups.en: What would you automate if you had two weeks?
follow_ups.zh: 如果給你兩週，你會自動化什麼？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 挑一個你真的被煩到的重複工作。

follow_ups.en: How do you check that your script is not lying to you?
follow_ups.zh: 你怎麼確認自己的程式沒有騙你？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講驗算方式：抽樣手算、和舊結果對照。

dont.en: I know Python, Java, C++, R, and machine learning.
dont.why_zh: 列一長串會被逐一追問，講不出深度反而扣分。

items.q: Tell me about a time your analysis turned out to be wrong.
items.q_zh: 講一次你的分析後來被證明是錯的。
items.intent_zh: 誠實度加反省力；答「我沒錯過」是最糟的答案。
outline_zh: 承認一個真實的錯誤
代價是什麼
你之後改變了什麼做法
items.answer: I once blamed a cleaning step for a particle issue. The correlation looked strong, so we changed the recipe, but the failure rate did not drop. I went back and found the real source was a new wafer carrier. I learned to check whether a correlation can be explained physically before I ask anyone to change a recipe.
items.answer_zh: 我曾經把一個微粒問題歸咎於某個清洗站。相關性看起來很強，所以我們改了配方，但失效率沒有下降。我回頭查，發現真正的來源是新的晶圓載具。我學到的是：在要求別人改配方之前，要先確認這個相關性在物理上解釋得通。
items.core: The correlation looked strong, so we changed the recipe, but the failure rate did not drop.

key_phrases.en: I went back and found the real source was ...
key_phrases.zh: 我回頭查，發現真正的來源是⋯

key_phrases.en: whether a correlation can be explained physically
key_phrases.zh: 這個相關性在物理上是否解釋得通

follow_ups.en: How did you tell your manager about it?
follow_ups.zh: 你怎麼跟主管講這件事？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你多快講、以及開口的第一句話。

follow_ups.en: What did it cost the team?
follow_ups.zh: 這件事讓團隊付出什麼代價？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講具體代價（幾天、幾批）；承認代價比淡化可信。

follow_ups.en: What do you do differently now?
follow_ups.zh: 你現在會怎麼做？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一個你之後固定執行的檢查動作。

dont.en: I cannot remember any analysis that was wrong.
dont.why_zh: 沒有人沒錯過；這樣答只會被讀成不誠實或沒在反省。

items.q: Explain what you do to someone who is not an engineer.
items.q_zh: 請用非工程師聽得懂的方式解釋你的工作。
items.intent_zh: 對非技術聽眾（HR、高階主管、客戶採購）解釋的能力。
outline_zh: 用日常語言講你的產品
一句話講你的工作
講你怎麼跟別人合作
items.answer: Every wafer we make has thousands of memory chips on it. Some of them fail the test, and my job is to find out why. I look at where the failures sit on the wafer, because the pattern tells me the cause. One pattern means a machine problem, another means a process step. Then I work with the process team to fix it.
items.answer_zh: 我們做的每一片晶圓上有數千顆記憶體晶片。其中有些會測試失敗，而我的工作就是找出原因。我會看失效落在晶圓上的什麼位置，因為分布圖案會告訴我是哪一台機台、哪一個站別造成的。接著我和製程團隊一起把它修好。
items.core: I look at where the failures sit on the wafer, because the pattern tells me the cause.

key_phrases.en: My job is to find out why.
key_phrases.zh: 我的工作就是找出原因。

key_phrases.en: the pattern tells me which machine or which step caused them
key_phrases.zh: 分布圖案會告訴我是哪台機台或哪個站別造成的

follow_ups.en: Why can't the machine tell you by itself?
follow_ups.zh: 機台自己不會告訴你嗎？

dont.en: I do yield analysis on 3D NAND using SPC and DOE methodology.
dont.why_zh: 對非技術聽眾丟術語，等於沒有溝通。

items.q: What is a yield excursion, and how do you find the root cause?
items.q_zh: 什麼是良率異常？你怎麼找根因？
items.intent_zh: 基本功：要能定義清楚，並講出可操作的流程。
outline_zh: 定義，並與一般變異區隔
第一步：signature 與晶圓圖
縮小範圍的方法（commonality）
items.answer: An excursion is a sudden yield drop outside the normal baseline, not the slow variation we see every day. I start from the failure signature and the wafer map pattern. Then I split the lots by process step and equipment to find a common tool. Commonality analysis usually points to one chamber within a day.
items.answer_zh: 所謂 excursion 是指突然掉出正常基線的良率下降，不是我們每天都看得到的緩慢變異。我會從失效特徵與晶圓圖案開始，接著把批次依站別與機台切開，找出共同的機台。共通性分析通常一天之內就能指向某一個腔體。
items.core: An excursion is a sudden yield drop outside the normal baseline.

key_phrases.en: I start from the failure signature and the wafer map pattern.
key_phrases.zh: 我從失效特徵與晶圓圖案開始。

key_phrases.en: Commonality analysis usually points to one chamber.
key_phrases.zh: 共通性分析通常會指向某一個腔體。

follow_ups.en: What if two tools show the same signal?
follow_ups.zh: 如果兩台機台都出現同樣的訊號呢？

dont.en: Yield excursion means the yield is bad.
dont.why_zh: 定義不精確會讓面試官懷疑你的基礎。

items.q: Walk me through how you run an 8D.
items.q_zh: 請說明你怎麼跑一份 8D。
items.intent_zh: 看你是真的跑過 8D，還是只背過名詞。
outline_zh: 用時間軸講 D1–D3（要快）
D4 根因（最花時間）
D5–D8 驗證與制度化
items.answer: D1 to D3 happen in the first two days: form the team, describe the problem with data, and contain the risk. D4 is the root cause, which takes the most time. In D5 and D6 we verify the fix on real lots before we release it. D7 is prevention, and in D8 we close with the customer.
items.answer_zh: D1 到 D3 在頭兩天完成：組隊、用資料描述問題、圍堵風險。D4 是根因，最花時間。D5、D6 我們在真實批次上驗證對策，確認有效才放行。D7 是預防，D8 與客戶結案。
items.core: In D5 and D6 we verify the fix on real lots before we release it.

key_phrases.en: D1 to D3 happen in the first two days.
key_phrases.zh: D1 到 D3 在頭兩天完成。

key_phrases.en: D4 is the root cause, which takes the most time.
key_phrases.zh: D4 是根因，最花時間。

follow_ups.en: Which D do most teams do badly?
follow_ups.zh: 多數團隊哪一個 D 做得最差？

dont.en: 8D is an eight step problem solving method from the automotive industry.
dont.why_zh: 背定義而不講你怎麼跑，面試官會判斷你沒實際做過。

items.q: How do you decide whether to scrap a lot or ship it with a waiver?
items.q_zh: 你怎麼決定一批貨要報廢還是特採出貨？
items.intent_zh: 商業判斷與底線；他們在看你會不會為了出貨賭風險。
outline_zh: 先講判斷依據（失效模式而非金額）
可靠度風險就報廢
可特採的條件與你的底線
items.answer: It depends on the failure mode, not on the value of the lot. If the failure is a reliability risk, we scrap, because a field return costs far more. If it only affects a non-critical parameter and the customer accepts it, I prepare a waiver with data and a clear boundary. I never ship a lot I cannot explain.
items.answer_zh: 取決於失效模式，不是這批貨值多少錢。如果是可靠度風險就報廢，因為市場退貨的代價高得多。如果只影響非關鍵參數而客戶也接受，我會準備附資料與明確界線的特採申請。我不會出任何一批我解釋不了的貨。
items.core: It depends on the failure mode, not on the value of the lot.

key_phrases.en: a field return costs far more
key_phrases.zh: 市場退貨的代價高得多

key_phrases.en: I prepare a waiver with data and a clear boundary.
key_phrases.zh: 我會準備附資料與明確界線的特採申請。

follow_ups.en: Has a manager ever pushed you to ship anyway?
follow_ups.zh: 有主管硬逼你出貨過嗎？

dont.en: I follow whatever my manager decides.
dont.why_zh: 這題問的就是你的判斷；把球丟回去等於沒有判斷力。

items.q: How do you separate a real signal from normal noise?
items.q_zh: 你怎麼分辨真訊號和一般雜訊？
items.intent_zh: 統計素養與工程判斷力。
outline_zh: 用歷史分布當基準
sigma 與樣本數的門檻
獨立量測交叉驗證
items.answer: I first ask how big the change is compared to the normal distribution of the last three months. If it is inside two sigma, I usually wait for more lots. I also check whether the same signal appears in an independent measurement. One lot is never enough to start an investigation.
items.answer_zh: 我會先問這個變化跟最近三個月的常態分布相比有多大。如果落在兩個標準差之內，我通常會再等幾批。我也會確認同樣的訊號是否出現在另一個獨立的量測上。單一批次永遠不足以啟動調查。
items.core: One lot is never enough to start an investigation.

key_phrases.en: compared to the normal distribution of the last three months
key_phrases.zh: 跟最近三個月的常態分布相比

key_phrases.en: whether the same signal appears in an independent measurement
key_phrases.zh: 同樣的訊號是否出現在獨立量測上

follow_ups.en: What if the customer asks for an answer after one lot?
follow_ups.zh: 如果客戶只看到一批就要答案呢？

dont.en: If the number looks bad, I report it immediately.
dont.why_zh: 把每個雜訊都當事件，會讓整條線疲於奔命。

items.q: How do you make sure a fix really works before it goes to production?
items.q_zh: 對策上線前，你怎麼確認它真的有效？
items.intent_zh: 驗證的嚴謹度；很多人只看良率數字回來就宣布結案。
outline_zh: 樣本數與對照組
看 signature 不只看數字
寫進管制計畫避免復發
items.answer: I run the fix on at least three lots and compare them with a control group from the same time window. I also check that the failure signature is gone, not only that the yield number is higher. If the fix passes, I ask the process team to write it into the control plan so it cannot drift back.
items.answer_zh: 我至少會在三批上跑對策，並和同一時間窗的對照組比較。我也會確認失效特徵消失了，而不是只看良率數字變高。如果通過，我會請製程團隊把它寫進管制計畫，避免慢慢飄回去。
items.core: I also check that the failure signature is gone, not only that the yield number is higher.

key_phrases.en: compare them with a control group from the same time window
key_phrases.zh: 和同一時間窗的對照組比較

key_phrases.en: write it into the control plan so it cannot drift back
key_phrases.zh: 寫進管制計畫，避免它慢慢飄回去

follow_ups.en: How many lots is enough for you?
follow_ups.zh: 你認為幾批算足夠？

dont.en: If the yield goes up, the fix works.
dont.why_zh: 良率回升可能只是別的因素；沒看 signature 等於沒驗證。

items.q: What do you do when the data does not give you a clear answer?
items.q_zh: 當資料給不出明確結論時，你怎麼辦？
items.intent_zh: 面對不確定性的誠實與結構化能力。
outline_zh: 先承認不確定
把已知／已排除／未決講清楚
提出一個能分辨假設的實驗
items.answer: I say so early instead of forcing a story. I list what we know, what we ruled out, and what is still open. Then I propose one experiment that can separate the two remaining hypotheses. If the experiment costs too much, I tell the team the risk of each option and let the owner decide.
items.answer_zh: 我會早點講出來，而不是硬掰一套說法。我會列出：我們知道什麼、已經排除什麼、還有什麼沒有結論。接著提出一個能區分剩下兩個假設的實驗。如果實驗成本太高，我會把每個選項的風險講清楚，讓負責人決定。
items.core: I list what we know, what we ruled out, and what is still open.

key_phrases.en: I say so early instead of forcing a story.
key_phrases.zh: 我會早點講，而不是硬掰一套說法。

key_phrases.en: one experiment that can separate the two remaining hypotheses
key_phrases.zh: 一個能區分剩下兩個假設的實驗

follow_ups.en: How do you report that to a customer?
follow_ups.zh: 這種狀況你怎麼對客戶報告？

dont.en: I keep looking until I find something to report.
dont.why_zh: 為了交差硬找關聯，遲早會出更大的事。

items.q: How do you keep up with new technology in this industry?
items.q_zh: 你怎麼跟上這個產業的新技術？
items.intent_zh: 學習習慣是可驗證的；來源與頻率比「我很愛學習」有用。
outline_zh: 外部來源與頻率
公司內部的學習管道
從客戶身上學到的東西
items.answer: I read the IEDM and IRPS papers that are related to my failure modes, usually two or three a month. Inside the company I join the design review when a new generation starts, even when it is not my product. I also learn a lot from customer questions, because they test our parts in ways we do not.
items.answer_zh: 我讀和我負責的失效模式相關的 IEDM、IRPS 論文，大概一個月兩三篇。公司內部，新世代開案時我會去參加設計審查，即使那不是我的產品。我也從客戶的問題學到很多，因為他們測我們的產品的方式跟我們不一樣。
items.core: I also learn a lot from customer questions, because they test our parts in ways we do not.

key_phrases.en: usually two or three a month
key_phrases.zh: 大概一個月兩三篇

key_phrases.en: I join the design review when a new generation starts.
key_phrases.zh: 新世代開案時我會參加設計審查。

follow_ups.en: Tell me about the last paper you read.
follow_ups.zh: 講一下你最近讀的一篇論文。

dont.en: I always keep learning new things every day.
dont.why_zh: 沒有來源與頻率的學習宣言，面試官不會採信。

items.q: Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager.
items.q_zh: 講一次你和主管意見不合的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 看你能不能有原則地反對，而不是硬碰硬或全盤服從。
outline_zh: 分歧點是什麼（對事不對人）
你用什麼證據溝通
結果，含你願意付出的成本
items.answer: My manager wanted to release a fix based on one good lot. I thought the sample was too small, so I showed him the historical variation of that parameter. I asked for two more lots and offered to run them over the weekend. He agreed, and the third lot did fail, so we avoided shipping a bad fix.
items.answer_zh: 我主管想憑一批好的結果就放行對策。我認為樣本太小，所以我給他看那個參數的歷史變異。我要求再跑兩批，並主動說我週末來跑。他同意了，而第三批確實失敗，我們因此避免放行一個沒效的對策。
items.core: I asked for two more lots and offered to run them over the weekend.

key_phrases.en: I thought the sample was too small, so I showed him ...
key_phrases.zh: 我認為樣本太小，所以我給他看⋯

key_phrases.en: we avoided shipping a bad fix
key_phrases.zh: 我們避免了放行一個沒效的對策

follow_ups.en: What if he had said no?
follow_ups.zh: 如果他還是說不呢？

dont.en: I never disagree with my manager.
dont.why_zh: 在外商這是負面訊號，代表你不會主動提出風險。

items.q: Describe a time you worked under a very tight deadline.
items.q_zh: 描述一次你在極短期限下工作的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 時間壓力下的取捨與溝通，不是「我加班到很晚」。
outline_zh: 期限被壓到多短
你怎麼平行化與取捨
主動溝通與交付結果
items.answer: A customer needed our 8D in five days instead of the usual thirty. I split the work: the module team ran the experiment while I prepared the data and the report at the same time. I also told the customer on day two what we already knew. We delivered on day five with a clear open item list.
items.answer_zh: 客戶要求五天內給 8D，而不是平常的三十天。我把工作拆開：模組團隊跑實驗，同時我準備資料與報告。我也在第二天就先告訴客戶我們已經知道的部分。第五天交件，並附上明確的未結項清單。
items.core: I also told the customer on day two what we already knew.

key_phrases.en: I split the work so two things could run at the same time.
key_phrases.zh: 我把工作拆開，讓兩件事同時進行。

key_phrases.en: We delivered on day five with a clear open item list.
key_phrases.zh: 我們第五天交件，並附上明確的未結項清單。

follow_ups.en: What did you drop to make it in time?
follow_ups.zh: 為了趕上，你捨棄了什麼？

dont.en: I worked until midnight every day and finished it.
dont.why_zh: 用工時證明能力，面試官只會擔心你不會安排優先順序。

items.q: Tell me about a mistake you made at work.
items.q_zh: 講一個你在工作上犯過的錯。
items.intent_zh: 看你怎麼處理錯誤，而不是有沒有犯錯。
outline_zh: 承認一個真實但不致命的錯
你多快、怎麼補救
你留下了什麼制度
items.answer: I once sent a customer report with the wrong lot numbers in the summary table. The customer found it before I did. I corrected the file within the hour, explained what happened, and added a rule that a second engineer checks every number before a report goes out. It has not happened again in two years.
items.answer_zh: 我曾經寄出一份客戶報告，摘要表裡的批號是錯的，而且是客戶先發現的。我在一小時內更正檔案、說明事情經過，並加了一條規則：報告發出前由第二位工程師覆核每一個數字。兩年來沒有再發生過。
items.core: The customer found it before I did.

key_phrases.en: I corrected the file within the hour and explained what happened.
key_phrases.zh: 我在一小時內更正檔案並說明經過。

key_phrases.en: a second engineer checks every number before a report goes out
key_phrases.zh: 報告發出前由第二位工程師覆核每個數字

follow_ups.en: How did the customer react?
follow_ups.zh: 客戶的反應是什麼？

dont.en: My mistake is that I work too hard and care too much.
dont.why_zh: 包裝成優點的假錯誤，面試官一聽就知道你在閃。

items.q: How do you work under pressure when the line is down?
items.q_zh: 產線停線的壓力下，你怎麼工作？
items.intent_zh: 壓力下的行為模式；他們要聽到可複製的做法，不是個性宣稱。
outline_zh: 你的固定順序
第一小時做什麼
你為什麼不會慌（機制而非個性）
items.answer: I keep the sequence fixed: contain first, then communicate, then investigate. In the first hour I stop the risk and tell the program manager what is on hold. I don't start deep analysis until the bleeding stops. Having a fixed sequence is what keeps me calm, not being naturally calm.
items.answer_zh: 我的順序是固定的：先圍堵、再溝通、最後才調查。第一個小時我先止住風險，並告訴 program manager 有哪些貨被 hold。止血之前我不會開始深入分析。讓我保持冷靜的是這個固定順序，不是我天生冷靜。
items.core: Having a fixed sequence is what keeps me calm, not being naturally calm.

key_phrases.en: contain first, then communicate, then investigate
key_phrases.zh: 先圍堵、再溝通、最後才調查

key_phrases.en: I don't start deep analysis until the bleeding stops.
key_phrases.zh: 止血之前我不會開始深入分析。

follow_ups.en: Who do you call first?
follow_ups.zh: 你第一個通知誰？

dont.en: I am a calm person, pressure does not affect me.
dont.why_zh: 個性宣稱無法驗證；講流程才可信。

items.q: Tell me about a time you had to persuade someone who did not report to you.
items.q_zh: 講一次你必須說服不歸你管的人。
items.intent_zh: 影響力；重點在你有沒有站在對方的 KPI 想事情。
outline_zh: 你要的東西為什麼對方不想給
你怎麼換成對方在意的語言
你加碼降低對方成本，結果
items.answer: I needed the module team to stop a tool for two days, which hurt their output target. Instead of asking for the tool, I showed them the cost of the scrap we would take if we kept running. I also offered to run the qualification wafers myself. They agreed the same afternoon.
items.answer_zh: 我需要模組團隊把一台機台停兩天，那會影響他們的產出目標。我沒有直接要機台，而是給他們看：如果繼續跑，我們要吃下多少報廢成本。我也主動說認證片由我來跑。他們當天下午就答應了。
items.core: Instead of asking for the tool, I showed them the cost of the scrap we would take.

key_phrases.en: which hurt their output target
key_phrases.zh: 那會影響他們的產出目標

key_phrases.en: I also offered to run the qualification wafers myself.
key_phrases.zh: 我也主動說由我來跑認證片。

follow_ups.en: What if they had refused?
follow_ups.zh: 如果他們拒絕呢？

dont.en: I escalated to my manager to push them.
dont.why_zh: 第一步就升級，代表你沒有影響力、只有靠山。

items.q: Tell me about a time you had to say no.
items.q_zh: 講一次你必須說「不行」的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 有沒有原則，以及會不會用「不行，但可以這樣」的方式拒絕。
outline_zh: 對方要什麼、為什麼不行
用風險語言解釋
給替代方案
items.answer: Sales asked me to sign a waiver for a lot with a marginal retention result. I said no, and I explained that retention affects data in the field, not only the test number. I offered a different option: ship the lots that passed and rescreen the rest. We lost two days but we did not take a field risk.
items.answer_zh: 業務要我簽一批 retention 結果在邊緣的特採。我拒絕了，並解釋 retention 影響的是產品在客戶端的資料保存，不只是測試數字。我給了另一個選項：先出過關的批，其餘重篩。我們多花兩天，但沒有承擔市場端的風險。
items.core: I said no, and I explained that retention affects data in the field.

key_phrases.en: I offered a different option.
key_phrases.zh: 我提供了另一個選項。

key_phrases.en: We lost two days but we did not take a field risk.
key_phrases.zh: 我們多花兩天，但沒有承擔市場端的風險。

follow_ups.en: How did sales react?
follow_ups.zh: 業務的反應如何？

dont.en: I told them it is not my responsibility.
dont.why_zh: 拒絕又不給替代方案，會被貼上難合作的標籤。

items.q: Give me an example of a conflict with a colleague.
items.q_zh: 舉一個你和同事起衝突的例子。
items.intent_zh: 衝突處理；重點是把爭論拉回資料。
outline_zh: 爭點是什麼
你怎麼降溫（把爭論轉成實驗）
結果與後續關係
items.answer: A test engineer and I disagreed about whether the failures came from the test program or the wafer. It became personal in the meeting, so I stopped the discussion and suggested we design one experiment together. We ran the same wafers on two testers. The data showed it was the wafer, and he accepted it immediately.
items.answer_zh: 我和一位測試工程師爭論失效到底來自測試程式還是晶圓本身。會議上開始針對人，所以我先喊停，提議我們一起設計一個實驗。我們把同一批晶圓放到兩台測試機上跑。資料顯示問題出在晶圓，他當場就接受了。
items.core: I stopped the discussion and suggested we design one experiment together.

key_phrases.en: It became personal in the meeting.
key_phrases.zh: 會議上開始針對人。

key_phrases.en: We ran the same wafers on two testers.
key_phrases.zh: 我們把同一批晶圓放到兩台測試機上跑。

follow_ups.en: What if the data had shown you were wrong?
follow_ups.zh: 如果資料證明是你錯呢？

dont.en: I avoid conflict, I just do my part.
dont.why_zh: 迴避衝突在跨部門工作等於問題被放著爛。

items.q: Tell me about a process you improved.
items.q_zh: 講一個你改善過的流程。
items.intent_zh: 主動改善的習慣；要有前後對比的數字。
outline_zh: 原本的痛點與成本（時間／人力）
你做了什麼
量化結果與擴散
items.answer: Our weekly yield review used to take four hours because everyone made their own slides. I built one dashboard that pulls the numbers automatically from the database. Now the meeting takes ninety minutes and we spend the time on decisions, not on formatting. Six teams use the same dashboard today.
items.answer_zh: 我們的週良率會議以前要開四小時，因為每個人各做各的投影片。我做了一個會自動從資料庫抓數字的儀表板。現在會議只要九十分鐘，時間花在決策而不是排版上。今天有六個團隊在用同一個儀表板。
items.core: Now the meeting takes ninety minutes and we spend the time on decisions.

key_phrases.en: used to take four hours because everyone made their own slides
key_phrases.zh: 以前要四小時，因為每個人各做各的投影片

key_phrases.en: Six teams use the same dashboard today.
key_phrases.zh: 今天有六個團隊在用同一個儀表板。

follow_ups.en: How did you get the other teams to adopt it?
follow_ups.zh: 你怎麼讓其他團隊願意採用？

dont.en: I always try to improve things when I have time.
dont.why_zh: 沒有案例與數字的改善宣言等於沒說。

items.q: Why are you looking for a new opportunity?
items.q_zh: 你為什麼想換工作？
items.intent_zh: 確認你的動機是「往前」而不是「逃離」，以及會不會講前東家壞話。
outline_zh: 肯定現職學到什麼
說出成長天花板在哪
講你要往哪裡去，不批評別人
items.answer: I have learned a lot in yield analysis, but my scope has stayed the same for the last two years. I want a role with more direct customer work and more influence on the next product generation. I'm not leaving because of my team; I still have a good relationship with my manager.
items.answer_zh: 我在良率分析學到很多，但我的守備範圍這兩年沒有變過。我想要一個能更直接面對客戶、也能影響下一個世代產品的位置。我不是因為團隊的關係要走，我和主管的關係一直很好。
items.core: I want a role with more direct customer work and more influence on the next product generation.

key_phrases.en: my scope has stayed the same for the last two years
key_phrases.zh: 我的守備範圍這兩年沒有變過

key_phrases.en: I'm not leaving because of my team.
key_phrases.zh: 我不是因為團隊的關係要離開。

follow_ups.en: Did you try to change your scope internally?
follow_ups.zh: 你有嘗試在內部爭取轉換嗎？

dont.en: My manager is bad and the company has no future.
dont.why_zh: 批評前東家是最常見的淘汰理由，面試官會假設你之後也會這樣講他們。

items.q: Why do you want to join our company?
items.q_zh: 你為什麼想加入我們公司？
items.intent_zh: 測你有沒有做功課，以及你要的東西這裡是否給得起。
outline_zh: 兩個具體理由，至少一個是這家公司獨有的
把理由連回你的能力
不要講薪水與知名度
items.answer: Two reasons. Your controller and NAND teams sit in the same site, so the failure analysis loop is much shorter than where I am now. Second, this role owns the customer interface, which is the part of my current job I enjoy most. I want to do that full time instead of ten percent of the time.
items.answer_zh: 兩個理由。你們的控制器團隊和 NAND 團隊在同一個廠區，失效分析的循環比我現在的環境短很多。第二，這個職位擁有客戶介面，而那正是我現在工作裡最喜歡的部分。我想全職做那件事，而不是只佔工作的一成。
items.core: This role owns the customer interface, which is the part of my current job I enjoy most.

key_phrases.en: the failure analysis loop is much shorter
key_phrases.zh: 失效分析的循環短很多

key_phrases.en: I want to do that full time instead of ten percent of the time.
key_phrases.zh: 我想全職做那件事，而不是只佔一成工作。

follow_ups.en: What do you know about our product roadmap?
follow_ups.zh: 你對我們的產品路線圖了解多少？

dont.en: Because your company is famous and the salary is good.
dont.why_zh: 這兩個理由對任何公司都成立，等於沒有理由。

items.q: Where do you see yourself in five years?
items.q_zh: 五年後你希望自己在什麼位置？
items.intent_zh: 看你的方向與這個職位是否一致，也在看你有沒有真的想過。
outline_zh: 給一個具體角色，不是職稱夢
說出需要補齊的能力
誠實講管理或技術路線
items.answer: In five years I want to be the technical owner for a full product line, not only for sort yield. That means understanding design and test well enough to argue with both. I'm less interested in managing headcount, at least until I have that technical depth.
items.answer_zh: 五年後我想成為一整條產品線的技術負責人，而不只是負責 sort yield。那代表我對設計端和測試端的理解，要足以和他們對等地爭論。我對管人數比較沒興趣，至少在技術深度到位之前不是。
items.core: In five years I want to be the technical owner for a full product line.

key_phrases.en: understanding design and test well enough to argue with both
key_phrases.zh: 對設計與測試的理解足以和雙方爭論

key_phrases.en: I'm less interested in managing headcount.
key_phrases.zh: 我對管人數比較沒有興趣。

follow_ups.en: What if this role does not lead there?
follow_ups.zh: 如果這個職位不通往那裡呢？

dont.en: I want to be a manager in five years.
dont.why_zh: 只講職稱不講能力，面試官無法判斷你是否想清楚。

items.q: What are your strengths?
items.q_zh: 你的優勢是什麼？
items.intent_zh: 要的是與職位相關、而且能舉證的強項。
outline_zh: 一個核心強項，用工作語言定義
舉證
第二個強項，最好是溝通面
items.answer: My strength is turning messy data into a decision. I'm comfortable joining test data, equipment history, and process logs, and I can usually tell the team what to check first. The second one is that I write reports people actually read, because I put the conclusion on the first page.
items.answer_zh: 我的強項是把雜亂的資料變成一個決策。我很習慣把測試資料、機台履歷和製程 log 併在一起，通常也能告訴團隊該先查哪裡。第二個是我寫的報告別人真的會看，因為我把結論放在第一頁。
items.core: I write reports people actually read, because I put the conclusion on the first page.

key_phrases.en: turning messy data into a decision
key_phrases.zh: 把雜亂的資料變成一個決策

key_phrases.en: I can usually tell the team what to check first.
key_phrases.zh: 我通常能告訴團隊先查哪裡。

follow_ups.en: Give me an example from last month.
follow_ups.zh: 舉一個上個月的例子。

dont.en: I am responsible, hard-working, and a good team player.
dont.why_zh: 三個萬用形容詞，和這份工作沒有連結。

items.q: What is your weakness?
items.q_zh: 你的弱點是什麼？
items.intent_zh: 要一個真實、有代價、但你已經在管理的弱點。
outline_zh: 一個真的弱點（不是包裝的優點）
它造成過什麼代價
你現在用什麼機制控制它
items.answer: I go too deep too early. On the furnace case I spent two weeks on a detail that did not change the conclusion. Now I set a time box: if a branch does not change the decision within two days, I stop and write down why. It is still something I have to watch.
items.answer_zh: 我太早鑽太深。在爐管那個案子上，我花了兩週在一個不會改變結論的細節上。現在我會設時間盒：如果一條線索兩天之內不會改變決策，我就停下來並寫下原因。這件事我到現在還是要提醒自己。
items.core: If a branch does not change the decision within two days, I stop and write down why.

key_phrases.en: I go too deep too early.
key_phrases.zh: 我太早鑽太深。

key_phrases.en: It is still something I have to watch.
key_phrases.zh: 這件事我到現在還是要提醒自己。

follow_ups.en: Has that time box ever made you miss something?
follow_ups.zh: 這個時間盒有沒有讓你漏掉過什麼？

dont.en: I am a perfectionist.
dont.why_zh: 面試官聽過幾千次，會直接判定你沒有準備。

items.q: What motivates you at work?
items.q_zh: 工作上什麼事情能激勵你？
items.intent_zh: 看你的動力來源和這個職位的日常是否匹配。
outline_zh: 一個具體的時刻，不是抽象價值
一個長期的成就感來源
可以誠實講什麼會消耗你
items.answer: I like the moment when a pattern finally makes sense, when the wafer map and the equipment history line up. The second thing is seeing a fix stay in the control plan a year later. I don't get much energy from meetings where nothing is decided.
items.answer_zh: 我喜歡的是圖案終於說得通的那一刻——當晶圓圖和機台履歷對得起來的時候。第二件事是看到一個對策一年後還留在管制計畫裡。至於什麼都沒決定的會議，我從裡面得不到什麼能量。
items.core: I like the moment when a pattern finally makes sense.

key_phrases.en: when the wafer map and the equipment history line up
key_phrases.zh: 當晶圓圖與機台履歷對得起來的時候

key_phrases.en: seeing a fix stay in the control plan a year later
key_phrases.zh: 看到一個對策一年後還留在管制計畫裡

follow_ups.en: What part of your current job drains you?
follow_ups.zh: 目前工作哪個部分最消耗你？

dont.en: Money motivates me.
dont.why_zh: 就算是真的，這句話會讓面試官擔心你隨時被挖走。

items.q: What are your salary expectations?
items.q_zh: 你的期望薪資是多少？
items.intent_zh: 看你有沒有做過行情功課，以及會不會太早把底牌掀開。
outline_zh: 給區間不給單一數字，並說明是查過的
說明彈性在哪（base／bonus）
把問題丟回去問對方預算
items.answer: Based on my research for this level in this market, I'm looking at a range in total package rather than a single number. I'm flexible on the split between base and bonus. Before I give a final number, may I ask what range you have budgeted for this position?
items.answer_zh: 根據我查到的這個職級在這個市場的行情，我看的是整體待遇的一個區間，而不是單一數字。base 和 bonus 怎麼配我有彈性。在我給出最終數字之前，可以請問這個職位的預算區間嗎？
items.core: I'm flexible on the split between base and bonus.

key_phrases.en: Based on my research for this level in this market
key_phrases.zh: 根據我查到的這個職級在這個市場的行情

key_phrases.en: May I ask what range you have budgeted for this position?
key_phrases.zh: 請問這個職位的預算區間是多少？

follow_ups.en: What is your current salary?
follow_ups.zh: 你現在的薪水是多少？

dont.en: Whatever you think is fair is fine for me.
dont.why_zh: 完全不表態會被開在區間底部，也顯得沒做功課。

items.q: Are you willing to travel or relocate?
items.q_zh: 你願意出差或外派嗎？
items.intent_zh: 誠實表態，但可以講出條件與彈性。
outline_zh: 出差：直接說能，並給既有經驗
外派：給條件（期間、時程）
強調誠實優於先答應再反悔
items.answer: Yes for travel. I already go to Korea and Japan two or three times a year for customer meetings and audits. For relocation, I would consider it for a defined period, but I would need to discuss the timing with my family first. I would rather be honest now than change my answer later.
items.answer_zh: 出差沒問題。我本來就一年去韓國、日本兩三趟開客戶會議和稽核。外派的話，如果有明確期間我會考慮，但我需要先和家人討論時程。我寧可現在誠實講，也不要之後才改口。
items.core: I would rather be honest now than change my answer later.

key_phrases.en: for customer meetings and audits
key_phrases.zh: 去開客戶會議與稽核

key_phrases.en: I would consider it for a defined period.
key_phrases.zh: 如果有明確期間，我會考慮。

follow_ups.en: How long a rotation would work for you?
follow_ups.zh: 多長的外派期你可以接受？

dont.en: Yes, no problem, anytime, anywhere.
dont.why_zh: 沒有條件的全盤答應不可信，之後反悔代價更大。

items.q: When could you start?
items.q_zh: 你什麼時候可以到職？
items.intent_zh: 實務問題，但你的回答會透露你交接的責任感。
outline_zh: 給明確的預告期
可壓縮的空間
說明你要負責到底的部分
items.answer: My notice period is one month, and I have handover documents ready for my two products. If you need me earlier, I can try to shorten it to three weeks, but I would like to close the open 8D first. I don't want to leave a customer case in the middle.
items.answer_zh: 我的預告期是一個月，兩個產品的交接文件我已經準備好了。如果你們需要我早一點，我可以試著壓到三週，但我想先把手上還開著的 8D 結掉。我不想把客戶案子丟在半路。
items.core: I don't want to leave a customer case in the middle.

key_phrases.en: My notice period is one month.
key_phrases.zh: 我的預告期是一個月。

key_phrases.en: I have handover documents ready.
key_phrases.zh: 我的交接文件已經準備好了。

follow_ups.en: Do you have other offers in progress?
follow_ups.zh: 你手上還有其他 offer 在進行嗎？

dont.en: I can start tomorrow.
dont.why_zh: 馬上就能走，會讓人懷疑你在現職沒有被交付重要工作。

items.q: Do you have any questions for us?
items.q_zh: 你有什麼問題想問我們嗎？
items.intent_zh: 反問是最後的加分題；問題本身就在展示你怎麼思考。
outline_zh: 問一個具體的技術問題
說明你為什麼問
連回你能貢獻什麼
items.answer: Yes. What is the biggest technical problem this team is fighting right now, and how long has it been open? I ask because I want to know whether it is a data problem or an organization problem. That tells me where I would be useful in the first six months.
items.answer_zh: 有。這個團隊現在最頭痛的技術問題是什麼？它開著多久了？我這樣問是因為我想知道那究竟是資料的問題，還是組織的問題。那能讓我判斷前六個月我能在哪裡幫上忙。
items.core: What is the biggest technical problem this team is fighting right now?

key_phrases.en: how long has it been open
key_phrases.zh: 這個問題開著多久了

key_phrases.en: That tells me where I would be useful.
key_phrases.zh: 那能讓我知道我能在哪裡幫上忙。

follow_ups.en: Why does that matter to you?
follow_ups.zh: 這件事為什麼對你重要？

dont.en: No, I think you have explained everything.
dont.why_zh: 不反問等於沒興趣，是最常見的隱形扣分。

items.q: Do you have any questions about the role?
items.q_zh: 對這個職位你有什麼想問的？
items.intent_zh: 問成功標準等於在確認期待值，也讓對方看見你會對齊目標。
outline_zh: 問一年後的成功標準
問日常最緊密的合作對象
說明你為什麼需要知道
items.answer: How would you measure whether I am successful after the first year? I would also like to know who I work with most closely day to day. If the answer is the customer quality team, I should prepare differently than if it is the process team.
items.answer_zh: 第一年結束時，你們會用什麼標準判斷我做得成不成功？我也想知道日常最緊密合作的對象是誰。如果答案是客戶品質團隊，那我要準備的東西，會和答案是製程團隊時很不一樣。

dont.why_zh: 福利問題留給 HR 與談 offer 階段，別佔用技術面試的最後印象。

items.q: Is there anything else you want us to know?
items.q_zh: 還有什麼是你希望我們知道的？
items.intent_zh: 最後一題是你自己補上沒被問到的優勢，或先處理對方的疑慮（例如英文）。
outline_zh: 主動點出對方可能的疑慮
用事實而不是保證去回應
收在一句你的工作原則
items.answer: One thing. My English is not perfect, but I have run customer con-calls in English for three years and I have never missed a commitment date. If a technical point matters, I will ask again until I am sure I understand it. I would rather ask twice than deliver the wrong thing.
items.answer_zh: 有一件事。我的英文不完美，但我已經用英文主持客戶電話會議三年，而且從沒錯過承諾的日期。如果某個技術點很重要，我會再問一次，直到我確定自己聽懂為止。我寧可問兩次，也不要交錯東西。
items.core: I would rather ask twice than deliver the wrong thing.

key_phrases.en: I have never missed a commitment date.
key_phrases.zh: 我從沒有錯過承諾的日期。

key_phrases.en: I will ask again until I am sure I understand it.
key_phrases.zh: 我會再問一次，直到我確定聽懂為止。

follow_ups.zh: 開會聽不懂的時候你怎麼處理？

dont.en: No, nothing. Thank you.
dont.why_zh: 最後一次主動出擊的機會，放棄很可惜。

items.q: Tell me about a time you had to present in English.
items.q_zh: 講一次你必須用英文做簡報的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 這題在問「你的英文能不能上場」，不是在問簡報技巧。講一次真的發生過的，含被問問題的部分。
outline_zh: 場合、對象、時間長度
你怎麼準備（具體方法）
最難的是哪一段，後來怎麼樣
items.answer: Last quarter I gave the yield review to our customer in the US. I had about twenty minutes and four charts. I wrote the key message of each chart in one sentence first, then built the slides around those sentences. The hard part was the Q and A, not the talking. One engineer asked why our sample size was small, and I explained the split plan we used. After that call my manager asked me to run the review every quarter.
items.answer_zh: 上一季我對美國客戶做良率回顧，大約二十分鐘、四張圖。我先把每張圖的重點寫成一句話，再照那些句子做投影片。最難的是問答，不是講的部分。有位工程師問我們的樣本數為什麼那麼少，我解釋了我們用的 split 計畫。那場之後主管就讓我每季固定跑這個會議。
items.core: I wrote the key message of each chart in one sentence first

key_phrases.en: I had about twenty minutes and four charts.
key_phrases.zh: 我大約有二十分鐘、四張圖

key_phrases.en: The hard part was the Q and A, not the talking.
key_phrases.zh: 最難的是問答，不是講的部分

follow_ups.en: What would you do differently next time?
follow_ups.zh: 下次你會做什麼不一樣的？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一個具體改動，例如先寫每張圖的一句話重點。

follow_ups.en: How often do you use English at work now?
follow_ups.zh: 你現在工作上多常用英文？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給頻率與場合，不要只說「常常」。

follow_ups.en: What do you do when you cannot find the word?
follow_ups.zh: 想不到單字的時候你怎麼辦？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 示範你的救援句：Let me put it another way ...

dont.en: My English is not good, so I usually let my manager present.
dont.why_zh: 自己先把門關上。可以承認不完美，但要講你怎麼補。

items.q: How big were the projects you worked on?
items.q_zh: 你做過的專案規模多大？
items.intent_zh: 在量你的守備範圍：跨幾個單位、幾個人、多長時間，以及你在裡面是什麼位置。
outline_zh: 典型專案的長度與參與單位
一個具體例子的人數與地點
你怎麼在沒有職權的情況下推動
items.answer: Most of my projects run three to six months and involve the fab, the test team, and sometimes the customer. On the program disturb case I worked with about eight people across three sites. I was not their manager, so I ran it with a shared action list and a weekly call. I keep the scope small on purpose: one failure mode at a time, one owner for each action.
items.answer_zh: 我的專案多半三到六個月，會牽涉到廠端、測試團隊，有時還有客戶。program disturb 那件事我和三個廠區、大約八個人一起做。我不是他們的主管，所以我用一份共用的 action list 加每週一次會議來推。我刻意把範圍切小：一次只處理一個 failure mode，每個 action 只有一個負責人。
items.core: I was not their manager, so I ran it with a shared action list and a weekly call.

key_phrases.en: Most of my projects run three to six months.
key_phrases.zh: 我的專案多半三到六個月

key_phrases.en: I keep the scope small on purpose.
key_phrases.zh: 我刻意把範圍切小

follow_ups.en: What did you do when someone missed an action?
follow_ups.zh: 有人沒做到 action 的時候你怎麼辦？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你怎麼讓延遲及早浮現，而不是到期才發現。

follow_ups.en: How did you track it all without a project tool?
follow_ups.zh: 沒有專案工具你怎麼追？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你的最小可行做法（一張共用表＋一次週會）。

follow_ups.en: What is the biggest team you would be comfortable leading?
follow_ups.zh: 你能帶的最大團隊是多大？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給一個數字與理由，展現你知道自己的邊界。

dont.en: It was a very big project, very important.
dont.why_zh: 沒有數字就等於沒有規模。人數、地點、時間長度講出來就好。

items.q: How do you use statistics in your daily work?
items.q_zh: 你的日常工作怎麼用到統計？
items.intent_zh: 不是考統計學，是看你會不會在下結論前先確認差異是真的。
outline_zh: 先確認差異是不是雜訊
樣本數在跑之前就決定
對客戶怎麼用一個指標說明餘裕
items.answer: Mostly three things. First, I check whether a difference is real before I explain it, so I look at the spread of the baseline, not only the mean. Second, I decide how many lots I need before I run the split, not after. Third, I use Cpk to tell the customer how much margin we have. I am not a statistician, but I know when my sample is too small to say anything.
items.answer_zh: 主要三件事。第一，在解釋差異之前先確認它是真的，所以我看的是基準的分布寬度，不是只看平均。第二，樣本要幾批是在跑之前就決定，不是跑完再說。第三，我用 Cpk 告訴客戶我們還有多少餘裕。我不是統計專家，但我知道樣本什麼時候小到不能下任何結論。
items.core: I check whether a difference is real before I explain it

key_phrases.en: the spread of the baseline, not only the mean
key_phrases.zh: 基準的分布寬度，不是只看平均

key_phrases.en: I know when my sample is too small to say anything.
key_phrases.zh: 我知道樣本什麼時候小到不能下結論

follow_ups.en: How many wafers would you ask for, and why?
follow_ups.zh: 你會要幾片？為什麼是這個數字？

dont.en: I just use Excel to make the chart.
dont.why_zh: 把方法降級成工具操作，聽起來像不理解自己在做什麼。

items.q: Explain program disturb to me.
items.q_zh: 解釋一下 program disturb。
items.intent_zh: 看你能不能用乾淨的英文把機制講清楚，而且連得到「在產線上長什麼樣」。
outline_zh: 機制：鄰近 word line 吃到部分電壓
為什麼有些 cell 會被推過去
在 wafer map 上怎麼認出它
items.answer: When we program one word line, the cells on the neighbor word lines see part of the program voltage. Most of the time nothing happens, but if a cell sits near the read level, that small stress can push it over. So we see fails on the pages next to the one we wrote. In production it shows up as a pattern that follows the program order, which is how we tell it apart from a normal defect.
items.answer_zh: 當我們對一條 word line 下 program，鄰近 word line 上的 cell 會吃到一部分的 program 電壓。多數時候沒事，但如果某個 cell 本來就靠近讀取準位，那點應力就會把它推過去。所以我們會在剛寫的那頁旁邊看到 fail。在產線上它會呈現出跟著 program 順序走的圖形，我們就是靠這點把它和一般缺陷分開。
items.core: we see fails on the pages next to the one we wrote

key_phrases.en: the cells on the neighbor word lines see part of the program voltage
key_phrases.zh: 鄰近 word line 的 cell 會吃到一部分 program 電壓

key_phrases.en: which is how we tell it apart from a normal defect
key_phrases.zh: 我們就是靠這點把它和一般缺陷分開

follow_ups.en: How would you reduce it without losing program speed?
follow_ups.zh: 在不犧牲 program 速度的前提下怎麼降低它？

follow_ups.en: How is read disturb different?
follow_ups.zh: read disturb 又不一樣在哪？

dont.en: It is a kind of disturb issue in NAND.
dont.why_zh: 等於沒回答。技術題的評分點是機制，不是名詞。

items.q: What can a wafer map tell you?
items.q_zh: 一張 wafer map 能告訴你什麼？
items.intent_zh: 看你有沒有「看圖形決定先找誰」的實務直覺。
outline_zh: 不同圖形分別指向什麼
重複在同一個 die 位置代表什麼
圖形的角色是縮小範圍，不是給答案
items.answer: The shape tells me where to look first. Edge fails usually point to the process at the wafer edge. A ring or a spiral often points to a tool. Random single bits look more like particles. If the pattern repeats in the same die location, it is more likely design or layout than process. The map does not give me the answer, but it tells me which team I should call first.
items.answer_zh: 圖形告訴我先看哪裡。邊緣 fail 通常指向晶圓邊緣的製程。環狀或螺旋通常指向某台機台。隨機的單點比較像微粒。如果圖形固定重複在同一個 die 位置，那比較可能是設計或 layout，而不是製程。這張圖不會給我答案，但它告訴我該先找哪個團隊。
items.core: The map does not give me the answer, but it tells me which team I should call first.

key_phrases.en: The shape tells me where to look first.
key_phrases.zh: 圖形告訴我先看哪裡

key_phrases.en: it is more likely design or layout than process
key_phrases.zh: 比較可能是設計或 layout，而不是製程

follow_ups.en: What would make you suspect the test program instead?
follow_ups.zh: 什麼情況下你反而會懷疑測試程式？

dont.en: I look at the map and I know the root cause.
dont.why_zh: 過度自信。圖形只能縮小範圍，講得像水晶球會被追殺。

items.q: How do you work with the fab to confirm a root cause?
items.q_zh: 你怎麼和廠端一起確認根因？
items.intent_zh: 看你會不會設計實驗，以及理論被推翻時的態度。
outline_zh: 跑之前先寫下預期結果（對與不對各一）
和廠端談定片數與讀取點
資料回來一起看，錯了就承認
items.answer: I ask for a split lot. I write down what I expect to see if my theory is right, and also what I expect if it is wrong, before the lot runs. Then I agree with the fab on the number of wafers and the read points. When the data comes back we look at it together on the same call. If the split does not separate, I say so and go back to the data instead of defending my theory.
items.answer_zh: 我會要一個 split lot。在批次跑之前，我先寫下如果理論正確會看到什麼、如果錯了又會看到什麼。接著和廠端談定片數與讀取點。資料回來時我們在同一場會議上一起看。如果 split 沒分開，我就直說，然後回去看資料，而不是護著自己的理論。
items.core: I write down what I expect to see if my theory is right

key_phrases.en: I agree with the fab on the number of wafers and the read points.
key_phrases.zh: 我和廠端談定片數與讀取點

key_phrases.en: instead of defending my theory
key_phrases.zh: 而不是護著自己的理論

follow_ups.en: What if the fab does not have capacity for a split?
follow_ups.zh: 如果廠端沒有產能跑 split 呢？

dont.en: I tell the fab what to do and wait for the result.
dont.why_zh: 把廠端當下游。外商很在意你能不能對等地和別的單位合作。

items.q: The customer sees a fail we cannot reproduce. What do you do?
items.q_zh: 客戶說有 fail，但我們重現不出來，你怎麼處理？
items.intent_zh: 這是客戶端最常見的地雷題。重點是：不要把「重現不出來」當成結論。
outline_zh: 先問到對方的確切條件
在自己的平台上重建那個條件
同時給 containment 讓客戶產線能動
items.answer: First I ask for their exact conditions: temperature, voltage, timing, and how many units. Then I try to match those conditions on our bench instead of arguing about the spec. I also ask for the failing units back, because the part usually tells us more than the report does. While that runs I give the customer a containment plan so their line keeps moving. I do not say we cannot reproduce it and stop there.
items.answer_zh: 我會先問到他們的確切條件：溫度、電壓、時序、幾顆。然後在我們自己的平台上重建那個條件，而不是先去爭 spec。我也會要求把 fail 品寄回來，因為實物講的通常比報告多。這段期間我先給客戶 containment，讓他們的產線能繼續動。我不會丟一句「我們重現不出來」就結案。
items.core: I try to match those conditions on our bench instead of arguing about the spec

key_phrases.en: I ask for the failing units back.
key_phrases.zh: 我會要求把 fail 品寄回來

key_phrases.en: so their line keeps moving
key_phrases.zh: 讓他們的產線能繼續動

follow_ups.en: What if it turns out to be their board design?
follow_ups.zh: 如果最後發現是他們的板子設計問題呢？

dont.en: It passes our spec, so it is not our problem.
dont.why_zh: 技術上也許對，但這句話會直接結束合作關係。

items.q: How do you know when an analysis is finished?
items.q_zh: 你怎麼判斷一個分析已經做完了？
items.intent_zh: 看你分不分得清「相關」與「根因」，以及有沒有驗證的紀律。
outline_zh: 說得出機制
對策有效且沒有副作用
只有相關性時要老實說
items.answer: When I can explain the mechanism, show that the fix removes the fail, and show that it does not break anything else. If I only have a correlation, I say it is a correlation. In an 8D that is the difference between D4 and D5: I am not done at root cause, I am done when the verification data is in.
items.answer_zh: 當我能說出機制、能證明對策把 fail 消掉、而且能證明它沒有弄壞別的東西。如果我手上只有相關性，我就說那是相關性。在 8D 裡這就是 D4 和 D5 的差別：找到根因不算做完，驗證資料回來才算做完。
items.core: I am not done at root cause, I am done when the verification data is in

key_phrases.en: If I only have a correlation, I say it is a correlation.
key_phrases.zh: 只有相關性我就說那是相關性

key_phrases.en: show that it does not break anything else
key_phrases.zh: 證明它沒有弄壞別的東西

follow_ups.en: How long do you keep monitoring after the fix?
follow_ups.zh: 對策上線後你會監控多久？

dont.en: When my manager says it is enough.
dont.why_zh: 把判準交給別人，等於說你沒有自己的標準。

items.q: How do you tell a design issue from a process issue?
items.q_zh: 你怎麼分辨這是設計問題還是製程問題？
items.intent_zh: 看你有沒有一條可操作的判準，而不是憑感覺。
outline_zh: 製程問題跟著機台、批次、位置走
設計問題跟著 layout 走
判定是設計就要早點拉人進來
items.answer: Process issues usually move with the tool, the lot, or the position on the wafer. Design issues show up in the same die location on every wafer and follow the layout. So I look at whether the fail follows the layout or follows the process history. If it follows the layout, I bring the design team in early, because that fix takes much longer.
items.answer_zh: 製程問題通常會跟著機台、批次或晶圓上的位置變動。設計問題則是每片晶圓都出現在同一個 die 位置，跟著 layout 走。所以我看的是：這個 fail 跟著 layout，還是跟著製程履歷。如果是跟著 layout，我會早點把設計團隊拉進來，因為那種對策要花的時間長得多。
items.core: I look at whether the fail follows the layout or follows the process history

key_phrases.en: Process issues usually move with the tool, the lot, or the position.
key_phrases.zh: 製程問題通常跟著機台、批次或位置變動

key_phrases.en: I bring the design team in early.
key_phrases.zh: 我會早點把設計團隊拉進來

follow_ups.en: Give me a case where you were wrong about this.
follow_ups.zh: 舉一個你判斷錯的例子。

dont.en: Design always says it is process, and process always says it is design.
dont.why_zh: 當笑話講可以，當答案講就變成抱怨，沒有回答問題。

items.q: Tell me about a time you received difficult feedback.
items.q_zh: 講一次你收到不好聽的回饋。
items.intent_zh: 看你能不能接受批評並真的改。第一反應可以誠實講不服氣，但後面要有動作。
outline_zh: 回饋內容與你的第一反應
你做了什麼去驗證它
改了什麼，結果是什麼
items.answer: My manager told me my reports were too technical for the customer. My first reaction was that the detail was necessary. Then I read one of my old reports as if I were the customer, and he was right. I changed the format: one page with the conclusion and the risk first, and the detail in the appendix. The customer started replying the same day instead of asking three follow-up questions.
items.answer_zh: 主管跟我說我的報告對客戶來說太技術了。我第一反應是覺得那些細節有必要。後來我把自己舊的報告當成客戶來讀一次，發現他是對的。我改了格式：第一頁只放結論和風險，細節放附錄。之後客戶當天就回信，而不是再問三輪。
items.core: I read one of my old reports as if I were the customer, and he was right

key_phrases.en: My first reaction was that ...
key_phrases.zh: 我第一反應是⋯

key_phrases.en: one page with the conclusion and the risk first
key_phrases.zh: 第一頁只放結論和風險

follow_ups.en: Has anyone given you the same feedback since?
follow_ups.zh: 後來還有人給過你同樣的回饋嗎？

dont.en: I have never received negative feedback.
dont.why_zh: 不可信，而且等於說你沒有成長過。

items.q: Tell me about working with people in another country.
items.q_zh: 講一次你和不同國家的人共事的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 這個職位要面對海外客戶，所以他們在看你有沒有處理時差與溝通落差的實際辦法。
outline_zh: 實際的時差與會議安排
你做了什麼讓會議有效率
語言上你調整了什麼
items.answer: I work with a customer team in the US, so the calls are late at night for me. Two things helped. I send the data before the call so we spend the call on decisions, not on reading charts. And I stopped using words like maybe and almost, because they were read as we do not know. If I am not sure, I now say what I know and when I will know the rest.
items.answer_zh: 我和美國的客戶團隊合作，所以會議對我來說都在深夜。有兩件事很有用。一是我在會前先把資料送出去，讓會議時間花在做決定，而不是看圖。二是我不再用 maybe、almost 這種字，因為對方會理解成「你們自己也不知道」。現在如果我不確定，我會講我知道什麼、以及什麼時候會知道其餘的部分。
items.core: I send the data before the call so we spend the call on decisions

key_phrases.en: the calls are late at night for me
key_phrases.zh: 會議對我來說都在深夜

key_phrases.en: I say what I know and when I will know the rest.
key_phrases.zh: 我講我知道什麼、什麼時候會知道其餘的

follow_ups.en: What is the biggest cultural difference you noticed?
follow_ups.zh: 你觀察到最大的文化差異是什麼？

dont.en: Communication was difficult because of my English.
dont.why_zh: 把問題全歸在語言上，聽起來像沒有解法。

items.q: Tell me about a time you delivered bad news to a customer.
items.q_zh: 講一次你必須向客戶報壞消息。
items.intent_zh: 看你會不會拖延壞消息，以及有沒有能力在資訊不全時就先溝通。
outline_zh: 壞消息是什麼、你多快講
你給了哪三件事
對方反應與後果
items.answer: We found that a shipped lot might contain the same failure mode. I told the customer the same day, before we knew the full impact. I gave them three things: what we knew, what we did not know yet, and what we were doing in the next twenty-four hours. They were not happy, but they kept the line running with our containment. Telling them late would have cost us the account.
items.answer_zh: 我們發現已出貨的一個批次可能有同樣的 failure mode。我在當天就告訴客戶，那時我們還不知道完整影響範圍。我給了他們三件事：我們已知的、還不知道的、以及接下來二十四小時要做的。他們當然不高興，但靠我們的 containment 產線沒有停。如果晚講，這個客戶大概就沒了。
items.core: I told the customer the same day, before we knew the full impact

key_phrases.en: what we knew, what we did not know yet
key_phrases.zh: 我們已知的、還不知道的

key_phrases.en: they kept the line running with our containment
key_phrases.zh: 靠我們的 containment 產線沒有停

follow_ups.en: Who decided to tell them that early?
follow_ups.zh: 那麼早通知是誰決定的？

dont.en: I waited until we had the full 8D before telling them.
dont.why_zh: 在品質圈這是紅線：晚通知比壞消息本身更嚴重。

items.q: Give me an example of taking ownership outside your job.
items.q_zh: 講一次你主動扛起不屬於你職責的事。
items.intent_zh: 看你是不是只做被交代的事。重點是「為什麼你會注意到」和「別人現在還在用嗎」。
outline_zh: 你注意到什麼問題、它花掉你多少時間
你做了什麼（要小而具體）
現在還在被使用嗎
items.answer: Our failure data was spread across three spreadsheets, and nobody owned it. It was not my job, but I was losing half a day every week looking for old cases. I built a simple shared table with a fixed format and asked two colleagues to use it for one month. Now the whole team uses it, and a new engineer can find a similar case in minutes instead of asking around.
items.answer_zh: 我們的失效資料散在三個試算表裡，沒有人負責。這不是我的工作，但我每週要花半天在翻舊案子。我做了一張格式固定的共用表，先請兩位同事用一個月看看。現在整個團隊都在用，新人可以在幾分鐘內找到類似案例，不用到處問人。
items.core: It was not my job, but I was losing half a day every week looking for old cases

key_phrases.en: nobody owned it
key_phrases.zh: 沒有人負責

key_phrases.en: I asked two colleagues to use it for one month.
key_phrases.zh: 我先請兩位同事用一個月看看

follow_ups.en: How did you get the rest of the team to adopt it?
follow_ups.zh: 你怎麼讓其他人也開始用？

dont.en: That is not my responsibility, so I reported it to my manager.
dont.why_zh: 回報沒有錯，但這題問的就是你自己做了什麼。

items.q: Tell me about a time you had too many things at once.
items.q_zh: 講一次你同時被太多事情壓住的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 在看你的排序邏輯，以及你會不會主動把取捨攤在主管面前。
outline_zh: 同時有哪幾件事
你用什麼標準排序、跟誰確認
最後每一件的結果
items.answer: During a qualification I had three lots, a customer report, and an excursion in the same week. I asked my manager which one could wait, and I told him what I would drop if nothing changed. The excursion came first because the line was affected. The report moved two days with the customer's agreement. The qualification stayed on schedule because I asked the test team to run the read points overnight.
items.answer_zh: 一次 qualification 期間，同一週我手上有三個批次、一份客戶報告，還來了一個 excursion。我去問主管哪一件可以等，並直接告訴他如果什麼都不變我會放掉哪一件。excursion 排第一，因為產線受影響。報告在客戶同意下延兩天。qualification 沒有延誤，因為我請測試團隊把讀取點排在夜班跑。
items.core: I asked my manager which one could wait

key_phrases.en: I told him what I would drop if nothing changed.
key_phrases.zh: 我告訴他如果什麼都不變我會放掉哪一件

key_phrases.en: The report moved two days with the customer's agreement.
key_phrases.zh: 報告在客戶同意下延兩天

follow_ups.en: What if your manager had said all of them are top priority?
follow_ups.zh: 如果主管說每件都最優先呢？

dont.en: I just worked overtime and finished everything.
dont.why_zh: 聽起來像沒有優先順序，而且不可持續。

items.q: Tell me about a time new data changed your mind.
items.q_zh: 講一次新資料推翻了你原本的判斷。
items.intent_zh: 看你面對自己錯誤的速度。這題答得好，技術可信度會一起上升。
outline_zh: 你原本的判斷與依據
什麼資料推翻了它
你多快、對誰承認，之後怎麼收
items.answer: I was sure a fail came from the etch step, and I had a correlation to support it. Then the split lot came back and both legs failed the same way. I stopped the analysis and told the team my theory was wrong on the next call. We went back to the sort data and found the real signal in the test program setup. Saying it early cost me nothing and saved us two weeks.
items.answer_zh: 我原本很確定 fail 來自蝕刻站，而且有相關性支持。結果 split lot 回來，兩組都以同樣方式 fail。我停掉分析，在下一次會議上就告訴團隊我的理論錯了。我們回頭看 sort 資料，在測試程式設定裡找到真正的訊號。早點講出來我什麼都沒損失，還省了兩週。
items.core: I stopped the analysis and told the team my theory was wrong on the next call

key_phrases.en: both legs failed the same way
key_phrases.zh: 兩組都以同樣方式 fail

key_phrases.en: Saying it early cost me nothing.
key_phrases.zh: 早點講出來我什麼都沒損失

follow_ups.en: How did the team react?
follow_ups.zh: 團隊的反應是什麼？

dont.en: I kept looking for data to support my theory.
dont.why_zh: 這正是他們最怕的工程師：先有結論再找資料。

items.q: Tell me about a time you helped a junior engineer.
items.q_zh: 講一次你帶新人的經驗。
items.intent_zh: 資深職位一定會問。重點是方法，不是「我人很好」。
outline_zh: 對方卡在哪
你用什麼方法（要具體）
結果，以及你自己學到什麼
items.answer: A new engineer joined and was afraid to present to the customer. I asked him to run our internal review first, and I sat in the room without speaking. Afterwards we went through only two things he should change, not ten. Two months later he ran the customer call himself. I learned that giving two comments works better than giving a full list.
items.answer_zh: 有位新人剛進來，很怕對客戶做報告。我請他先主持我們內部的檢討會，我坐在會議室但不說話。結束後我們只挑兩件要改的講，不是十件。兩個月後他自己主持了客戶會議。我自己學到的是：給兩個意見比給一整張清單有效。
items.core: I asked him to run our internal review first

key_phrases.en: I sat in the room without speaking.
key_phrases.zh: 我坐在會議室但不說話

key_phrases.en: only two things he should change, not ten
key_phrases.zh: 只挑兩件要改的，不是十件

follow_ups.en: How do you handle someone who does not take advice?
follow_ups.zh: 遇到聽不進意見的人你怎麼辦？

dont.en: I told him everything I knew about the job.
dont.why_zh: 資訊傾倒不是帶人。面試官要聽的是你怎麼取捨。

items.q: Tell me about a time you missed a commitment.
items.q_zh: 講一次你沒有做到自己承諾的事。
items.intent_zh: 承認失誤只是第一步，他們真正在看的是你怎麼提前示警、以及你改了什麼制度。
outline_zh: 承諾是什麼、為什麼沒做到
你多早示警、示警時給了什麼
之後你改了什麼做法
items.answer: I promised the customer an 8D in two weeks, and the FA equipment was down for five days. I did not wait until the deadline to tell them. On day three I sent a short update with the new date and the reason, and I sent the containment part on time. We still missed the original date. Since then I give a date for each step, not one date for the whole report.
items.answer_zh: 我答應客戶兩週內給 8D，結果 FA 設備停機五天。我沒有等到期限那天才講。第三天我就寄了一封簡短更新，說明新的日期與原因，而 containment 的部分照原訂時間送出。原訂日期我們還是沒趕上。從那之後我改成每個步驟各給一個日期，而不是整份報告只給一個日期。
items.core: I did not wait until the deadline to tell them

key_phrases.en: I sent a short update with the new date and the reason.
key_phrases.zh: 我寄了簡短更新，說明新日期與原因

key_phrases.en: I give a date for each step, not one date for the whole report.
key_phrases.zh: 每個步驟各給一個日期，而不是整份只給一個

follow_ups.en: How did the customer respond to the new date?
follow_ups.zh: 客戶對新日期的反應是什麼？

dont.en: It was not my fault, the equipment was down.
dont.why_zh: 理由可以講，但先講理由會變成推責。順序要先承認再解釋。

items.q: What kind of manager do you work best with?
items.q_zh: 你和什麼樣的主管合作最順？
items.intent_zh: 表面問偏好，實際在對你和這個團隊的管理風格。答案要正向，但要具體到能讓對方判斷。
outline_zh: 你要的是什麼（目標與界線清楚）
你不需要什麼（每日盯進度）
你希望對方在什麼時候介入
items.answer: Someone who tells me the goal and the constraints, and then lets me decide how to get there. I do not need daily direction, but I do want to hear early if my priorities are wrong. I also work well with a manager who is willing to say I do not know, because then the team can say it too.
items.answer_zh: 會把目標和限制講清楚，然後讓我自己決定怎麼做到的人。我不需要每天被指方向，但如果我的優先順序抓錯了，我希望早點聽到。我也很能配合願意說「我不知道」的主管，因為那樣團隊才敢跟著這麼說。
items.core: Someone who tells me the goal and the constraints

key_phrases.en: I do not need daily direction.
key_phrases.zh: 我不需要每天被指方向

key_phrases.en: willing to say I do not know
key_phrases.zh: 願意說「我不知道」

follow_ups.en: What if your manager is very hands-on?
follow_ups.zh: 如果主管管得很細呢？

dont.en: Any manager is fine for me.
dont.why_zh: 沒有資訊量。這題是給你展示工作方式的機會。

items.q: How do you feel about calls across time zones?
items.q_zh: 你能接受跨時區的會議嗎？
items.intent_zh: 他們要確認你知道代價、而且不會三個月後就受不了。誠實給範圍比一味說沒問題好。
outline_zh: 你現在的實際狀況（已經在做）
你能接受的頻率
你希望的條件交換
items.answer: I already take customer calls at ten or eleven at night, so I know what it costs. It is fine two or three times a week if the calls are real decisions. What I would ask for is that we do not use a late call for something an email can do. I also start later on those mornings, and my current team is fine with that.
items.answer_zh: 我現在就有晚上十點、十一點的客戶會議，所以我知道代價是什麼。如果是真的要做決定的會議，一週兩三次沒問題。我唯一會要求的是：email 講得完的事就不要排深夜會議。那幾天早上我會晚一點進辦公室，現在的團隊也接受。
items.core: It is fine two or three times a week if the calls are real decisions

key_phrases.en: so I know what it costs
key_phrases.zh: 所以我知道代價是什麼

key_phrases.en: something an email can do
key_phrases.zh: email 講得完的事

follow_ups.en: What if it becomes four or five nights a week?
follow_ups.zh: 如果變成一週四五天呢？

dont.en: No problem at all, any time works.
dont.why_zh: 過度承諾。對方也知道不可能，反而覺得你沒想清楚。

items.q: Do you have other offers?
items.q_zh: 你手上有其他 offer 嗎？
items.intent_zh: 在探你的時間壓力與行情。誠實講時程比虛張聲勢安全，但要順帶表態偏好。
outline_zh: 有就照實說到哪一關
給出你的時間點
表明這個職位為什麼是你想要的
items.answer: I am in the final round with one other company. I am not using it as leverage, and I would rather tell you my timeline than play games. I need to give them an answer by the end of next week. Your role is the one that matches what I want to do next, so if we can keep to that timeline, that helps me.
items.answer_zh: 我另外有一家在最後一關。我沒有要拿它來抬價，比起玩心理戰我寧可直接告訴你我的時程。我下週末前要回覆對方。你們這個職位才是符合我下一步想做的事的那一個，所以如果流程能配合這個時間，對我幫助很大。
items.core: I am not using it as leverage

key_phrases.en: I would rather tell you my timeline than play games.
key_phrases.zh: 比起玩心理戰我寧可直接告訴你我的時程

key_phrases.en: if we can keep to that timeline, that helps me
key_phrases.zh: 如果流程能配合這個時間，對我幫助很大

follow_ups.en: What would make you choose us over them?
follow_ups.zh: 什麼會讓你選我們而不是他們？

dont.en: Yes, and they offered me much more money.
dont.why_zh: 把談判提早到還沒拿到 offer 的階段，常常直接出局。

items.q: What would you need to know before accepting an offer?
items.q_zh: 在接受 offer 之前，你會想知道什麼？
items.intent_zh: 這是給你問實質問題的機會。問「怎麼被衡量」比問「公司文化如何」有效得多。
outline_zh: 這個職位怎麼被衡量
主要合作對象是誰
出差與工作型態
items.answer: I would ask three things. How is this team measured, and what does a good year look like for this role? Who would I work with most often, the fab or the customer? And how often does this role travel? Those tell me more than the title does.
items.answer_zh: 我會問三件事。這個團隊怎麼被衡量？這個職位「表現好的一年」長什麼樣？我最常合作的對象是廠端還是客戶？以及這個職位多常出差？這幾題告訴我的，比職稱多得多。
items.core: How is this team measured, and what does a good year look like for this role?

key_phrases.en: Who would I work with most often?
key_phrases.zh: 我最常合作的對象是誰？

key_phrases.en: Those tell me more than the title does.
key_phrases.zh: 這些比職稱告訴我的多得多

follow_ups.en: Anything about the team you would want to know?
follow_ups.zh: 關於團隊你還想知道什麼？

dont.en: I would mainly want to know the salary and the bonus.
dont.why_zh: 不是不能問，但放在第一個問，會蓋掉其他訊號。

items.q: What would you need from us in your first month?
items.q_zh: 第一個月你會需要我們提供什麼？
items.intent_zh: 在看你有沒有把自己放進那個位置想過。答得具體，等於免費示範你上工後的樣子。
outline_zh: 你需要的資源（要具體）
你知道真正的門檻不是技術
你打算怎麼加速
items.answer: Access to the data and one person I can ask stupid questions. In my experience the technical part takes two weeks and the context takes two months: which customers are sensitive, which tools are known to drift, who decides a waiver. If someone can spend thirty minutes a week with me on that, I will be useful much faster.
items.answer_zh: 資料權限，以及一位可以讓我問蠢問題的人。以我的經驗，技術部分兩週就上手，真正花時間的是背景脈絡：哪些客戶敏感、哪些機台會漂、waiver 由誰決定，這些要兩個月。如果有人每週能給我三十分鐘講這些，我可以快很多。
items.core: the technical part takes two weeks and the context takes two months

key_phrases.en: one person I can ask stupid questions
key_phrases.zh: 一位可以讓我問蠢問題的人

key_phrases.en: I will be useful much faster.
key_phrases.zh: 我可以更快變得有用

follow_ups.en: What would you want to achieve in the first quarter?
follow_ups.zh: 第一季你想達成什麼？

dont.en: Nothing, I can figure everything out by myself.
dont.why_zh: 聽起來不是自信，是不打算和團隊合作。

items.q: Give me the thirty-second version.
items.q_zh: 用三十秒講一次就好。
items.intent_zh: 面試官時間不夠，或在測你能不能壓縮。三十秒版本要能單獨活著，不是把一分鐘版本講快一點。
outline_zh: 一句定位：職稱＋年資＋領域
一個代表作＋一個數字
一句「為什麼坐在這裡」
items.answer: Device engineer, six years, NAND flash yield analysis. I find why wafers fail at sort and close the issue with the fab. Last year I led the root cause analysis on a program disturb excursion worth three points of yield. I want a role that puts me closer to the customer.
items.answer_zh: 元件工程師，六年，NAND flash 良率分析。我負責找出晶圓在 sort 失效的原因，並和廠端一起把問題收掉。去年我主導了一次 program disturb 異常的根因分析，那次值三個百分點的良率。我想找一個離客戶更近的職位。
items.core: I find why wafers fail at sort and close the issue with the fab.

key_phrases.en: Device engineer, six years, NAND flash yield analysis.
key_phrases.zh: 名詞開場，省掉主詞動詞——三十秒版本的省字法

key_phrases.en: I want a role that puts me closer to ...
key_phrases.zh: 我想找一個離⋯更近的職位

follow_ups.en: Now give me the two-minute version.
follow_ups.zh: 那再給我兩分鐘的版本。
follow_ups.tip_zh: 同一個骨架加細節，不要換一套講法——面試官在對兩個版本一不一致。

follow_ups.en: Which of those two versions is the real you?
follow_ups.zh: 這兩個版本哪一個才是真的你？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 回答「都是」，並說明為什麼在不同場合要有不同長度。

follow_ups.en: What did you leave out just now?
follow_ups.zh: 你剛剛省略了什麼？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 誠實說你砍掉了什麼、為什麼那部分優先度低。

dont.en: Sure — so I was born in Taichung, and after graduation I joined...
dont.why_zh: 三十秒版本一講到出身就已經超時了。

items.q: Walk me through your last three years.
items.q_zh: 講一下你最近三年。
items.intent_zh: 在對時間線。要能一段一段講清楚「什麼時候、做什麼、為什麼移動」，中間不能有講不清楚的空白。
outline_zh: 每一段一句話：時間＋角色＋負責什麼
段與段之間講清楚為什麼移動
收在現在，接到為什麼想換
items.answer: Three years ago I moved from process integration to the device team. The first year I ran routine sort analysis and learned the test flow. In the second year I took over the customer return cases, which is when I started joining customer calls. This past year I led two excursions end to end, and that is when I realised I want the customer-facing part to be a bigger share of my job.
items.answer_zh: 三年前我從製程整合轉到元件團隊。第一年我做例行的 sort 分析，把測試流程摸熟。第二年我接手客訴退回案件，也是那時候開始參加客戶會議。過去這一年我從頭到尾主導了兩次 excursion，也是那時候我發現，我希望面對客戶的那部分在工作裡佔更大比重。
items.core: In the second year I took over the customer return cases

key_phrases.en: Three years ago I moved from ... to ...
key_phrases.zh: 三年前我從⋯轉到⋯

key_phrases.en: This past year I led two excursions end to end.
key_phrases.zh: 過去這一年我從頭到尾主導了兩次 excursion

follow_ups.en: Why did you move off process integration?
follow_ups.zh: 你為什麼離開製程整合？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你要往哪去，不要講你在逃什麼。

follow_ups.en: Which of those three years was the hardest?
follow_ups.zh: 這三年哪一年最難？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 挑一年並說出難在哪、你怎麼撐過去。

follow_ups.en: Is there anything on your resume you would explain differently?
follow_ups.zh: 履歷上有什麼是你想另外說明的嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 有短期任職或空窗就主動講；被追問到才講會像在藏。

dont.en: I have been doing yield analysis for three years.
dont.why_zh: 這是履歷第一行，不是時間線。對方要的是每一段的移動理由。

items.q: Why did you change jobs at that point?
items.q_zh: 你當時為什麼換工作？
items.intent_zh: 在找不穩定或逃避的訊號。理由要一致、要往前看，而且要和履歷上的時間對得起來。
outline_zh: 當時的推力（陳述事實，不抱怨）
當時的拉力（你想要什麼）
後來證明這個決定是對的
items.answer: The process team was moving to a new site, and I would have spent most of my week on the road. At the same time the device team needed someone who could read sort data, which was the part of the job I liked most. So I moved. Two years later I was leading the analysis for our largest customer, so I think the move was right.
items.answer_zh: 當時製程團隊要搬到新廠區，我一週大部分時間會花在路上。同一時間，元件團隊需要一個看得懂 sort 資料的人，而那正是我最喜歡的部分。所以我就轉了。兩年後我在負責我們最大客戶的分析，所以我認為那個決定是對的。
items.core: the device team needed someone who could read sort data

key_phrases.en: At the same time ... needed someone who could ...
key_phrases.zh: 同一時間⋯需要一個能⋯的人

key_phrases.en: so I think the move was right
key_phrases.zh: 所以我認為那個決定是對的

follow_ups.en: Would you have stayed if the site had not moved?
follow_ups.zh: 如果廠沒有搬，你會留下嗎？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 誠實回答，但要接回「拉力」——你本來就想做這一塊。

follow_ups.en: How do I know you will not leave us in two years?
follow_ups.zh: 我怎麼知道你兩年後不會又走？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講你這次要的是什麼、以及什麼條件下你會留很久，不要空口保證。

follow_ups.en: What would make you stay somewhere for five years?
follow_ups.zh: 什麼會讓你在一個地方待五年？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給具體條件（能一直接觸新的失效模式、有客戶接觸面），不要說「好的公司文化」。

dont.en: My manager and I did not get along.
dont.why_zh: 就算是真的，這句話會讓面試官假設你和下一個主管也處不來。

items.q: What have you learned in this role that you did not know two years ago?
items.q_zh: 這個職位上你學到什麼是兩年前不知道的？
items.intent_zh: 在看你有沒有真的成長，還是只是把同一年的經驗重複了三次。
outline_zh: 一個技術面的成長
一個工作方式的成長
誠實講你現在還在補的那一塊
items.answer: Two things. On the technical side, I learned to design the split before I run it, instead of collecting data and hoping the answer shows up. On the working side, I learned that a short update on day three is worth more than a perfect report on day fourteen. What I am still bad at is saying no early enough.
items.answer_zh: 兩件事。技術上，我學會在跑之前就把 split 設計好，而不是先收一堆資料、期待答案自己浮出來。工作方式上，我學到第三天的一封簡短更新，價值高過第十四天的一份完美報告。我到現在還不夠好的是——沒辦法夠早說不。
items.core: I learned to design the split before I run it

key_phrases.en: instead of collecting data and hoping the answer shows up
key_phrases.zh: 而不是先收一堆資料、期待答案自己浮出來

key_phrases.en: What I am still bad at is ...
key_phrases.zh: 我到現在還不夠好的是⋯

follow_ups.en: Who taught you that?
follow_ups.zh: 這是誰教你的？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給名字或角色（一位資深同事、一次失敗），比「自己領悟的」可信。

follow_ups.en: Give me an example where the old way failed you.
follow_ups.zh: 舉一個舊做法害到你的例子。
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一次具體的白費工，這一題答得出來才證明你真的學到了。

follow_ups.en: What do you want to learn in the next two years?
follow_ups.zh: 接下來兩年你想學什麼？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一個和這個職位有關的，順勢說明為什麼是這裡。

dont.en: I learned a lot about NAND.
dont.why_zh: 沒有資訊量。對方要的是「你現在做事跟以前有什麼不同」。

items.q: Tell me about a typical week in your current job.
items.q_zh: 你現在的工作，典型的一週長什麼樣？
items.intent_zh: 在對你的實際工作內容和履歷寫的一不一致，也在看你把時間花在哪、怎麼吸收突發狀況。
outline_zh: 固定的節奏（會議、報告）
花掉最多時間的那件事
不可預期的部分怎麼吸收
items.answer: Monday is the yield review, so I spend Friday preparing the numbers. Most of the week goes to open cases: pulling sort data, talking to the fab, and writing updates. I have two customer calls a month, usually late at night. The rest is whatever breaks. If an excursion comes in, everything else moves and I tell my manager what I am dropping.
items.answer_zh: 週一是良率回顧會議，所以我週五就在準備數字。一週大部分時間花在手上的案子：拉 sort 資料、和廠端溝通、寫進度更新。一個月有兩場客戶會議，通常在深夜。剩下的就是臨時爆掉的事。如果來了一個 excursion，其他都往後移，而我會告訴主管我要放掉哪一件。
items.core: Most of the week goes to open cases

key_phrases.en: Monday is the yield review, so I spend Friday preparing the numbers.
key_phrases.zh: 週一是良率回顧，所以我週五就在準備數字

follow_ups.en: How many cases do you carry at once?
follow_ups.zh: 你同時手上有幾個案子？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 給數字，並說你怎麼決定先做哪一個。

follow_ups.en: What takes more time than it should?
follow_ups.zh: 什麼事花的時間比應該的多？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 講一件真的低效率的事，順便講你試過怎麼改。

follow_ups.en: How much of that week is in English?
follow_ups.zh: 那一週裡有多少是用英文？
follow_ups.tip_zh: 誠實給比例與場合；這題常常是在探你的實際英文使用量。

dont.en: It depends, every week is different.
dont.why_zh: 對方要的是你怎麼安排時間，不是「我很忙」。
